race.comment: The big one of the day and one of Victoria's most iconic country cups, which carries $40k in prizemoney. The bulk of it could be heading over the border with SA raider TYUSIX (3) getting in beautifully here. She'll appreciate not having Giggenbach for competition here and started fav against that galloper last start when beaten 2.5 lengths in a metro race in SA. Draws well and gets in well with 53kg after the claim for Olivia East. MIRACLE SPIN (1) is proven at this level, having won the Apsley Cup at Edenhope earlier in the year and he'll be much better for the first-up run. Does have a lot of weight to contend with, so he'll need an economical run but the draws presents the chance to get that. SAXON BLOOD (7) wasn't far away last start and won the two prior so he has to go in. DARTBOARD (4) hasn't been far away recently and can feature in the finish once again.
